title: Rewinding the choice buffer
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$, $x$, and $u$ be Boolean words, let $p$ be any valid input-head position for input $y$, and let $j\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $j\le |u|$. Starting in loader state $5$ with input-head position $p$, choice buffer $u$, and choice-buffer head at position $j-1$, after exactly $j+1$ steps the pair-loader machine reaches the configuration obtained by embedding the initial configuration of $N$ on input $x$ in the simulation core, with boundary tag true, choice word $u$, choice-head index $0$, and physical input-head position $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$p$ is a valid input-head position for $y$
replaced: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine, let $x$ and $u$ be buffer words, and let $j \le |u|$. From the loader configuration in the choice-rewind state with choice head at position $j - 1$, exactly $j + 1$ steps of the pair-loader machine reach the renamed embedding of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ prepared with choice word $u$, preserving the physical input position.
